import.title: Import books
import.description: Add the books of a file exported from Goodreads, Calibre or LibraryThing to the library. Books already there are skipped.

drop.label: Choose a file or drop it here
drop.hint: CSV or TSV file, up to {size} MB.
drop.dragging: Drop the file to choose it

import.tooLarge: The file is too large: the limit is {size} MB.
import.unreadable: The file could not be read.

errors.unknownFormat: Unrecognized format or invalid file. Pick the format by hand, check that the first line holds the headers and that there are no more than 20,000 rows.

report.title: Import report
report.truncated: Showing the first {shown} rows with errors out of {total}.

export.title: Export the library
export.description: Save all the books to a file, to keep a copy or to open them in a spreadsheet.
